enforcement_points: Python candidate registry locks use uv lock --exclude-newer at the recorded cutoff.
Python artifact builds and clean installs receive UV_EXCLUDE_NEWER from the recorded cutoff.
note: Package owner Rene confirmed a seven-day hold-off for external dependencies on 2026-10-14. The fixed midnight UTC cutoff is conservative for this release. Python exceptions apply only to the verified first-party dependency edges of the selected package; external runtime and build dependencies retain the cutoff. No npm publication is requested by this Python release preparation.
